title: Mountain Silversage
wikitext:
'''Mountain Silversage''' is an [[Herb]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]] (280).

==Source==
Mountain Silversage can be found on mountainsides in various high level zones of Azeroth. Often, reaching the herb node requires a bit of climbing.
* [[Blasted Lands]]
* [[Un'Goro Crater]]
* [[Winterspring]]
